article_content: In 1997, Kevin Turner, a former Philadelphia Eagles fullback, suffered a nasty collision during a kickoff that left him disoriented. Despite the severity of the hit, the team's medical staff cleared him to continue playing. Turner is now battling ALS, a disease his lawyers claim is linked to the repeated head trauma he experienced during his NFL career. Turner is part of a growing number of former NFL players suing the league for alleged negligence in protecting players from head injuries. The NFL has denied the allegations, stating it has made significant efforts to improve player safety and understand the risks associated with head trauma.

article_content: Social media companies continue to allow 'harmful content' to reach young people, according to Ian Russell, father of Molly Russell. He is horrified by the scale of the issue and notes that 'little has changed' since Molly took her life at 14. Research by the Molly Rose Foundation shows young users can still access content related to suicide and self-harm on TikTok, Instagram, and Pinterest. The platforms assert they are working hard to protect teenagers and have developed new tools to limit access to harmful content.

Výskum nadácie Molly Rose preukázal, že mladí používatelia majú naďalej prístup k obsahu súvisiacemu so samovraždou a sebapoškodzovaním na TikTok, Instagram a Pinterest. Tieto platformy tvrdia, že pracujú na tom, aby ochránili teenagerov, a vyvinuli nové nástroje na obmedzenie prístupu k škodlivému obsahu.

article_content: Jack Wilshere has thrown his full support behind England team-mate Wayne Rooney and his position as captain of the national side. Rooney was named the new Three Lions skipper following Steven Gerrard's retirement after the World Cup. In his first match as captain, Rooney led Roy Hodgson's side to a 1-0 win over Norway at Wembley. Wilshere has backed Rooney's senior role, stating that the Manchester United star is respected in the dressing room and shows relevant leadership skills. 'He's great,' Wilshere said. 'Even before he was made captain, I looked up to him. He's a leader and isn't scared to tell you when you're doing something wrong.' Wilshere's form has been under scrutiny following mediocre showings for Arsenal, but he's convinced he can retain his England place alongside Jordan Henderson. 'I played with Jordan for a few years at under-21 level, and I worked well with him. He's fit and gets up the pitch well.' Wilshere also praised Arsenal's signing of Danny Welbeck, saying, 'He has great enthusiasm and quality on the ball.'

article_content: Leon Brittan gained a double first from Trinity College, Cambridge, before becoming a lawyer, MP, minister, and EU commissioner. Leon Brittan was hailed as 'by far and away the most brilliant of his generation' after a stellar career which took him from Hampstead to the House of Commons. Born on September 25, 1939, the son of a north London doctor who had emigrated from Berlin, Brittan was brought up in the Orthodox Jewish tradition. He won a scholarship from his state primary school to Haberdasher's Aske's School in Hampstead and went on to gain a double first from Trinity College, Cambridge. At university, he became president of the Union and chairman of the Conservative Association. In 1961, he was called to the Bar and pursued a successful career as a libel lawyer, taking silk in 1978. His ambitions to enter the House of Commons were frustrated for 10 years. He fought and lost North Kensington in 1966 and 1970 and was rejected as Tory candidate by more than a dozen safer Tory seats. Finally, he was elected for Cleveland and Whitby in 1974. Before long, he was in Mrs Thatcher's shadow team, first as a deputy spokesman on devolution and then in employment. When she won the 1979 election, Lord Brittan became minister of state at the Home Office. Within two years, he was in the Cabinet as chief secretary to the Treasury. Only days before that promotion, he married divorcee Diana Peterson, who had two daughters. In this post, he was an instant success, courteous and decisive, and quickly aware of areas where compromises could be successfully reached in his battle to keep public spending under control. But a cloud on the horizon was the projected disappearance of his parliamentary constituency. Lord Brittan, despite his proven ability, had trouble finding another seat to fight. But the intervention of the then-home secretary, Willie Whitelaw, helped him gain the safe seat of Richmond, Yorkshire. After the 1983 Tory landslide, Brittan became the youngest home secretary since Winston Churchill. But his apparently unstoppable rise was halted and then reversed by two issues. His decision to ask the BBC not to transmit a programme on Ulster terrorism made him the target of accusations of censorship and of handing the IRA a major propaganda victory. All this made him a liability, and Mrs Thatcher transferred him to trade and industry, which everyone except him regarded as a demotion. But within weeks, he was caught up in the battle over Westland. Brittan and the rest of the Cabinet wanted an American rescue package to save the company, while Heseltine alone wanted a European solution and openly campaigned for one against all his Cabinet colleagues. There followed the leaked letter, and then Brittan was forced to apologise to MPs for allegedly misleading them over a confidential letter to Mrs Thatcher from British Aerospace, part of the European consortium bidding to rescue Westland. He gained some support with a fighting Commons performance, denying he had lied to the House about an alleged meeting with BAe chief executive Sir Raymond Lygo. But hours later, Sir Raymond issued a long statement contradicting Brittan's version of events. Later, Sir Raymond amended that by saying there had been a 'misunderstanding'. It was too late; the 1922 Committee of Tory back-benchers demanded his resignation, and despite pleas by Mrs Thatcher for him to stay, Brittan had to quit. But he took this devastating blow with equanimity. 'I am bruised,' he said, 'but I am certainly not bowed. And I'm not looking back, nor in any state of nostalgia.' Brittan was appointed a European commissioner in 1989 and a year later became vice-president of the Commission. He stayed in Brussels for a decade and it was during this time he gave the now-Liberal Democrat Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg a job in his office. He returned to Westminster in 2000 as Lord Brittan of Spennithorne but remained low-key until Prime Minister David Cameron gave him a job as a trade adviser in 2010. Last year, he was put in the spotlight when allegations of historic sex abuse emerged, and Home Secretary Theresa May set up an inquiry to investigate. Lord Brittan was likely to be called to give evidence over a dossier he received from MP Geoffrey Dickens in 1983, documenting the alleged involvement of VIP figures in a child sex ring. He had flatly denied failing to act on the abuse file. The second woman appointed to chair the investigation, Fiona Woolf, was forced to quit over links to him - she was a neighbour. Lord Brittan is survived by his widow and two stepdaughters.
translated_content: Leon Brittan získal dvojité prvenstvo na Trinity College v Cambridge, predtým ako sa stal právnikom, poslancom, ministrom a komisárom EÚ. Leon Brittan bol dnes chválený ako 'najbrilantnejší zo svojej generácie' po hviezdnej kariére, ktorá ho priviedla z Hampsteadu do Dolnej snemovne. Narodil sa 25. septembra 1939 ako syn severolondýnskeho lekára, ktorý emigroval z Berlína, a bol vychovaný v ortodoxnej židovskej tradícii. Vyhral štipendium zo svojej štátnej základnej školy na Haberdasher's Aske's School v Hampstead a získal dvojité prvenstvo na Trinity College v Cambridge. Na univerzite sa stal prezidentom Únie a predsedom Konzervatívnej asociácie. V roku 1961 bol povolaný k Bar a pokračoval v úspešnej kariére ako právnik na ohovárania, pričom v roku 1978 získal hodnosť 'silk'. Jeho ambície vstúpiť do Dolnej snemovne boli frustrované 10 rokov. Bojoval a prehral v North Kensington v rokoch 1966 a 1970 a bol odmietnutý ako kandidát Tory viac ako tuctom bezpečnejších Tory kresiel. Nakoniec bol zvolený za Cleveland a Whitby v roku 1974. Čoskoro bol v tieni pani Thatcherovej, najprv ako zástupca hovorcu pre devolúciu a potom v zamestnaní. Keď vyhrala voľby v roku 1979, Lord Brittan sa stal ministrom štátu na ministerstve vnútra. Do dvoch rokov bol v Kabinete ako hlavný tajomník Pokladnice. Iba niekoľko dní pred týmto povýšením sa oženil s rozvedenou Dianou Petersonovou, ktorá mala dve dcéry. Na tomto poste bol okamžitým úspechom, zdvorilým a rozhodným, a rýchlo si uvedomil oblasti, kde by sa dalo úspešne dosiahnuť kompromisy v jeho boji za udržanie verejných výdavkov pod kontrolou. Oblak na horizonte však bolo plánované zánik jeho parlamentného volebného obvodu. Lord Brittan, napriek svojej osvedčenej schopnosti, mal problémy nájsť iné kreslo, za ktoré by bojoval. Ale intervencia vtedy ministra vnútra Willie Whitelawa mu pomohla získať bezpečné kreslo Richmond, Yorkshire. Po víťazstve Tory v roku 1983 sa Brittan stal najmladším ministrom vnútra od čias Winstona Churchilla. Ale jeho zdanlivo nebrzdený vzostup bol zastavený a potom obrátený dvomi problémami. Jeho rozhodnutie požiadať BBC, aby nepremierovala program o ulsterskom terorizme, z neho urobilo cieľ obvinenia zo cenzúry a z toho, že dal IRA veľké propagandistické víťazstvo. To všetko z neho urobilo záťaž a pani Thatcherová ho premiestnila do obchodu a priemyslu, čo všetci okrem neho považovali za degradáciu. Ale do niekoľkých týždňov bol zapletený do bitky o Westland. Brittan a zvyšok Kabinetu chceli americký záchranný balík na záchranu spoločnosti, zatiaľ čo Heseltine sám chcel európske riešenie a otvorene kampanil zaň proti všetkým svojim kolegom v Kabinete. Nasledoval uniknutý list a potom bol Brittan nútený ospravedlniť sa poslancom za údajné zavádzanie v súvislosti s konfidenciálnym listom pani Thatcherovej od British Aerospace, časti európskeho konzorcia, ktoré sa uchádzalo o záchranu Westlandu. Získal určitú podporu v boji proti Commons, keď odmietol, že lhal Snemovni o údajnom stretnutí s výkonným riaditeľom BAe Sir Raymondom Lygom. Ale o hodiny neskôr vydal Sir Raymond dlhé vyhlásenie, ktoré odporovalo Brittanovej verzií udalostí. Neskôr Sir Raymond upravil toto vyhlásenie, že došlo k 'neporozumeniu'. Bol to koniec; Výbor 1922 Toryovských poslancov požadoval jeho rezignáciu a napriek žiadostiam pani Thatcherovej, aby zostal, Brittan musel odísť. Ale tento deštruktívny úder niesol s vyrovnanosťou. 'Som otrasený,' povedal, 'ale určite nie zlomený. A nepozerám sa späť, ani nie som v žiadnom stave nostalgie.' Brittan bol vymenovaný za európskeho komisára v roku 1989 a o rok neskôr sa stal viceprezidentom Komisie. Zostal v Bruseli desať rokov a práve v tomto čase dal prácu v jeho úrade terajšiemu liberálnemu demokratovi a námestníkovi premiéra Nickovi Cleggovi. Do Westminsteru sa vrátil v roku 2000 ako Lord Brittan zo Spennithorne, ale zostal v ústraní, až kým mu premiér David Cameron v roku 2010 dal prácu ako obchodného poradcu. Minulý rok sa dostal do centra pozornosti, keď sa objavili obvinenia z historického sexuálneho zneužívania a ministerka vnútra Theresa Mayová ustanovila vyšetrovanie. Lord Brittan bol pravdepodobne vyzvaný, aby vypovedal o dosieri, ktorý dostal od poslanca Geoffreyho Dickensa v roku 1983, dokumentujúcom údajnú účasť významných osobností na sieti detskej prostitúcie. Plocho poprel, že by nekonal na základe spisu o zneužívaní. Druhá žena vymenovaná za predsedníčku vyšetrovania, Fiona Woolfová, bola nútená odstúpiť kvôli väzbám na neho - bola jeho susedkou. Lord Brittan je prežijúci svoju manželku a dve nevlastné dcéry.

article_content: Hope Murray believed she had found a solution for her daughter Meredith's healthcare needs when she discovered Direct Medical Network Solutions Inc. online. Meredith required medical attention following a car accident, but insurance companies were unwilling to provide coverage due to her pre-existing condition. Direct Medical Network Solutions Inc. offered a program with advertised discounts at doctors' offices and hospitals, promising $30 doctor visits and $50 specialist visits, with mentions of the prestigious Mayo Clinic. Murray paid $314 upfront and $179 monthly. However, when Meredith visited Dr. Robert Epsten, a gastroenterologist listed as part of Direct Med's network, the office claimed they had never heard of Direct Med and didn't accept their card. This scenario repeated with other healthcare providers. Murray expressed extreme anger, calling it a 'bogus scam' that 'hurts people.' The Federal Trade Commission and several states have taken action against numerous health discount card companies for offering non-existent discount services. Critics describe these cards as 'rip-offs' and warn consumers to be cautious. Despite this, 2 to 4 million people have purchased such cards, attracted by the promise of savings. The Consumer Health Alliance, a trade group representing companies selling these cards, acknowledges some dishonest operators but defends the majority of the industry. They provide a consumer guide for choosing discount health programs. Hope Murray eventually canceled her daughter's card after three months.

Meredith potrebovala lekársku starostlivosť po autonehode, ale poisťovne neboli ochotné poskytnúť pokrytie kvôli jej už existujúcemu zdravotnému stavu. Direct Medical Network Solutions Inc. ponúkla program so sľubnými zľavami v lekárskych ordináciách a nemocniciach, pričom sľubovala návštevy u lekára za 30 dolárov a u špecialistov za 50 dolárov, s zmienkou o prestížnej Mayo Clinic. Murrayová zaplatila 314 dolárov vopred a 179 dolárov mesačne. Avšak, keď Meredith navštívila Dr. Roberta Epstena, gastroenterológa uvedeného v sieti Direct Med, ordinácia tvrdila, že nikdy o Direct Med neslýchali a ich kartu neakceptujú. Tento scenár sa opakoval aj s inými poskytovateľmi zdravotnej starostlivosti. Murrayová vyjadrila extrémny hnev a označila to za 'podvodný scam', ktorý 'ubližuje ľuďom.' Federálny obchodný úrad a niekoľko štátov podnikli kroky proti mnohým spoločnostiam poskytujúcim zdravotné zľavové karty za ponúkanie neexistujúcich zľavových služieb. Kritici tieto karty označujú za 'vydieračstvo' a varujú spotrebiteľov, aby boli opatrní. Napriek tomu 2 až 4 milióny ľudí kúpili takéto karty, prilákané sľubom úspor. Consumer Health Alliance, obchodná skupina zastupujúca spoločnosti predávajúce tieto karty, uznáva niektorých nečestných prevádzkovateľov, ale bráni väčšinu odvetvia. Poskytujú spotrebiteľský sprievodca pre výber zľavových zdravotných programov. Nade Murrayová nakoniec zrušila kartu svojej dcéry po troch mesiacoch.

article_content: Our brain's simplest sensations involve seeing lightness and color. Neuroscience research indicates that we don't see the actual light that falls on our eyes or its real-world source. Instead, we see what's been useful to perceive in the past. Illusions are a powerful example of this. They occur because our brain evolved to interpret the 'meaninglessness' of the retinal image by redefining normality based on relationships, history, and ecology. We tend to find regularities in information and give them value. However, it's the value, not the information itself, that we perceive. When you look 'out into' the world, you're actually looking at an internal map of value-relations derived from your specific context. This understanding is crucial for personal and social well-being, as it helps us see that our perceptions aren't the world as it is, but rather our interpretation of it. By 'seeing ourselves see,' we can understand the source of coherence and conflict within and between individuals. Embracing uncertainty is key to finding new, enlightened ways of seeing and being. Courage, not confidence, is at the heart of redefining normality, leading to compassion and creativity.

Namiesto toho vnímame, čo bolo užitočné vnímať v minulosti. Ilúzie sú toho dobrým príkladom. Vznikajú, lebo sa náš mozog vyvinul tak, aby dal zmysel 'bezmyselnému' obrazu na sietnici pomocou vzťahov, histórie a ekológie. Hľadáme pravidelnosti v informáciách a dávame im hodnotu. Avšak vnímame hodnotu, nie informáciu samotnú. Keď ráno otvoríte oči a pozriete sa 'do sveta', pozeráte sa na vnútornú mapu hodnôt odvodenú z vášho kontextu. Toto pochopenie je dôležité pre našu pohodu, lebo nám pomáha pochopiť, že naše vnímanie nie je svet sám, ale naša jeho interpretácia. Tým, že 'vidíme seba vidieť', môžeme pochopiť zdroj súladu a konfliktov v nás a medzi ľuďmi. Prijatie neistoty je kľúčom k novým spôsobom videnia a bytia. Odvaha je základom predefinovania normality, čo vedie k súcitu a kreativite.

article_content: Victims of the Black Saturday bushfires have been handed a record $500 million payout. About 5,000 residents from the East Kilmore and Kinglake area in Victoria's north, who took part in the class action, will share $494.7 million. The Black Saturday bushfires broke out in February 2009 and were the worst natural disaster in Australia's history. The survivors sued SP AusNet, Utility Services Corporation Limited, and the Department of Sustainability and Environment after 119 lives were lost on February 7, 2009. The class action was settled without admission of liability and approved by Victoria Supreme Court Justice Robert Osborn. Lead plaintiff Carol Matthews, who lost her son Sam in the fires, said, 'We finally get to ease the financial struggle that so many people are facing on a day-to-day basis, and for that, I am really thankful.'

Približne 5 000 obyvateľov z oblasti East Kilmore a Kinglake na severe Victorie, ktorí sa zúčastnili hromadnej žaloby, si rozdelia 494,7 milióna dolárov. Požiare na 'Black Saturday', ktoré vypukli vo februári 2009, boli najhoršou prírodnou katastrofou v histórii Austrálie. Preživší zažalovali SP AusNet, Utility Services Corporation Limited a Department of Sustainability and Environment po strate 119 životov. Vedúca žalobkyňa Carol Matthews, ktorá stratila svojho syna Sama, povedala: 'Konečne môžeme zmierniť finančné problémy, ktorým čelí toľko ľudí každý deň, a za to som naozaj vďačná.'

article_content: SINGAPORE: Singapore's government agencies reminded foreigners working or living in the country on Thursday not to use it as a platform to further their political causes amid the ongoing war between Israel and militant group Hamas. 'Given the heightened tensions, it's crucial to remain calm and not let these external events affect racial and religious harmony and peace in Singapore,' the Manpower Ministry (MOM) said in a Facebook post. 'We'd like to remind everyone to engage in responsible and respectful discussions on this sensitive topic.' A joint advisory by MOM, the Ministry of Home Affairs, and Internal Security Department reiterated Singapore's zero-tolerance approach to extremism, violence, or terrorism. Foreigners were asked not to 'support or import foreign politics,' including through public displays of materials like banners, flags, and posters. They were reminded not to write, post, or share information that may 'stir up emotions resulting in violence or cause hatred among different races or religions.' 'Doing so is an offence and punishable under Singapore law; offenders may be banned from working in Singapore,' the advisory stated. It also urged the foreign workforce not to speculate or spread unverified information 'that may cause discomfort to others.' Those wishing to donate to help conflict victims were advised to use official channels like the Singapore Red Cross or the Rahmatan Lil Alamin Foundation.

'Vzhľadom na zvýšené napätie je dôležité zostať pokojným a nedovoliť, aby tieto vonkajšie udalosti ovplyvnili rasovú a náboženskú harmóniu a mier v Singapure,' uviedlo Ministerstvo práce (MOM) v príspevku na Facebooku. 'Chceli by sme všetkým pripomenúť, aby sa zapájali do zodpovedaných a úctivých diskusií na túto citlivú tému.' Spoločné oznámenie MOM, Ministerstva vnútra a Oddelenia vnútornej bezpečnosti zopakovalo Singapurov prístup nulovej tolerancie voči extrémizmu, násiliu alebo terorizmu. Cudzcom bolo prikázané 'nepodporovať alebo importovať zahraničnú politiku,' a to aj prostredníctvom verejných prejavov materiálov ako bannery, vlajky a plakáty. Boli upozornení, aby nenapísali, neposielali alebo nezodpovedali informácie, ktoré by mohli 'vyvolať emócie vedúce k násiliu alebo spôsobiť nenávisť medzi rôznymi rasami alebo náboženstvami.' 'Takéto konanie je trestné podľa singapurského práva; páchatelia môžu byť vyhostení zo Singapuru,' uviedlo oznámenie. Zároveň vyzvalo zahraničných pracovníkov, aby nešpekulovali alebo nešírili neoverené informácie, 'ktoré môžu spôsobiť nepríjemnosti iným.' Tí, ktorí chcú darovať na pomoc obetiam konfliktu, boli vyzvaní, aby použili oficiálne kanály ako Singapurský Červený kríž alebo Nadáciu Rahmatan Lil Alamin.

article_content: The US Justice Department announced it would not bring federal charges against George Zimmerman, the former neighborhood watch volunteer who fatally shot Trayvon Martin in 2012. This decision, made during Attorney General Eric Holder's final days in office, concluded a case that drew national attention to self-defense laws and racial tensions. Zimmerman claimed he acted in self-defense when he shot the unarmed 17-year-old Martin in a confrontation in Sanford, Florida. The Justice Department's investigation focused on whether the shooting constituted a federal civil rights violation, requiring evidence that Zimmerman's actions were motivated by racial animosity. Despite Martin's family asserting that Zimmerman initiated the fight, the department found insufficient evidence to prove Zimmerman willfully violated Martin's civil rights or killed him because of his race.

Toto rozhodnutie, urobené počas posledných dní pôsobenia generálneho prokurátora Erica Holdera v úrade, ukončilo prípad, ktorý upriamil národnu pozornosť na zákony o sebaobrane a rasové napätie. Zimmerman tvrdil, že konal v sebaobrane, keď zastrelil 17-ročného Martina počas konfrontácie v Sanforde na Floride. Vyšetrovanie ministerstva spravodlivosti sa zameralo na to, či streľba predstavovala porušenie federálnych občianskych práv, čo by vyžadovalo dôkaz, že Zimmermanove činy boli motivované rasovou animozitou. Napriek tomu, že Martinova rodina tvrdila, že Zimmerman inicioval boj, ministerstvo nenašlo dostatočné dôkazy na to, aby dokázalo, že Zimmerman úmyselne porušil Martinove občianske práva alebo ho zabil kvôli jeho rase.

article_content: Imagine watching every single baseball game of the season - a dream for many, but potentially a daunting task. Major League Baseball has chosen two fans, Mike O'Hara and Ryan Wagner, to take on this challenge. Starting from the opening day, they'll be stationed in the newly created 'MLB Fan Cave' in lower Manhattan, watching 2,430 regular season games and all post-season games. The 'cave' is equipped with three 60-inch TVs and a dozen 32-inch TVs, alongside various entertainment zones like a deejay booth, a 1950s-style cafe, and a game room. O'Hara and Wagner will share their experiences on social media, through a blog on MLB.com, and on the MLB Network. 'This is a real-time experience that brings to life how people enjoy entertainment in 2011, with baseball at its center,' said Tim Brosnan, MLB's Executive Vice President of Business. The 15,000-square-foot space was designed by Paul DiMeo, known for 'Extreme Makeover: Home Edition.' It features an 18-foot statue of Willie Mays and a pitching alley. The 'MLB Fan Cave' will host events and offer services like haircuts and memorabilia appraisals.

article_content: Britain's families are bracing for a potential increase in the cost of their favorite 'fish and chip' meals, according to a recent report. Experts in the food industry warn that the price of 'fish and chips' is on the verge of rising due to a surge in cod prices, driven by dwindling supplies and escalating demand. Commodity analysts at Mintec reported a 25.7% year-on-year jump in the price per tonne for wholesale Norwegian cod, reaching £1,060. Mintec analyst Mark Kozlowski attributed the sharp price rise to increased demand, particularly from China, and a drop in supply partly caused by a 10% reduction in the Barents Sea quota. With Norwegian cod making up around 20% of the cod consumed in the UK, Kozlowski warned that the current stock situation could lead to 'tighter supplies,' potentially increasing prices for British consumers. The report also notes that cod is not the only seafood experiencing price hikes; Norwegian coldwater prawns have seen a 57% price surge over the past 12 months. However, British consumers are unlikely to face higher prawn prices soon, as most prawns sold in the UK are warmwater prawns, whose prices are falling.

Nórska treska tvorí približne 20% tresky spotrebovanej v UK, Kozlowski varoval, že situácia so zásobami môže viesť k 'obmedzeným dodávkam,' čo môže zvýšiť ceny pre britských spotrebiteľov. article_content: Former England left-back Ashley Cole is considering moves to Barcelona or AC Milan after being released by Chelsea at the end of last season. Cole has received offers from both clubs, who are struggling to fill the left-back position. Barcelona relied on Brazilian Adriano towards the end of last season and continue to face issues following the sale of Eric Abidal to Monaco last summer. Cole has been targeted by Barcelona's new manager, Luis Enrique. AC Milan are also seeking new players after appointing Filippo Inzaghi as their new coach, replacing Clarence Seedorf. Many at Chelsea believe Cole, regarded as one of the best left-backs of all time, was unfairly treated by Jose Mourinho last season. At 33, Cole believes he still has much to offer and had hoped to remain in the Barclays Premier League. He had a brief recall to the Chelsea team for the Champions League clash with Atletico Madrid at the Vicente Calderon but failed to convince Mourinho to keep him. Cole retired from international football when the England head coach chose Leighton Baines and Southampton's Luke Shaw for the World Cup.

At 24, he co-founded Check Point, which developed the first firewall using 'stateful inspection'. Today, Check Point has nearly 3,000 staff and its software is used by every Fortune 100 company. Shwed explains that firewalls protect networks by controlling incoming and outgoing traffic. Check Point's ThreatCloud is a collaborative network that shares threat intelligence to fight cybercrime.

Dnes má Check Point takmer 3 000 zamestnancov a jeho softvér používajú všetky spoločnosti z Fortune 100. Shwed vysvetľuje, že firewally chránia siete kontrolou prichádzajúcej a odchádzajúcej prevádzky. Despite the pressure, Scolari was given a warm welcome by Neymar, who is a favourite with the Brazilian fans. article_content: Washington (CNN) -- A plane carrying Michelle Obama had to abort its landing on Monday after coming too close to a military C-17 cargo plane ahead of it. The planes were three miles apart, instead of the required five miles apart, according to a senior administration official and the Federal Aviation Administration. The FAA is investigating what went wrong, believed to be an air traffic controller mistake. The White House doesn't believe the first lady's life was ever in danger. The FAA instructed the incoming Boeing 737 to perform a 'go around' due to insufficient separation behind the military plane. Obama was on a C-40, a military version of the 737, part of the Air National Guard. The FAA didn't want Obama's plane caught in the 'jet wash' of the C-17. Maj. Michelle Lai said the FAA 'made the right call' and the first lady's life was never in danger. When Potomac TRACON handed off the plane to Andrews Air Force Base tower, the planes were three miles apart. The National Transportation Safety Board is gathering information to determine whether to investigate further.

article_content: Mauricio Pochettino can be excused if he has Barcelona on his mind as he attempts to become the first Tottenham manager to win at Chelsea since Terry Venables, nearly a quarter of a century ago. Pochettino had been in charge of Espanyol for only a few games in February 2009 when he took his struggling team to the Nou Camp and ended his team's 27-year winless run in the derby. 'I don't know how we did it,' said the Spurs boss. 'Espanyol were bottom and Barcelona were top, and all the people were saying Espanyol were dead and had no chance. Mauricio Pochettino brought his unfancied Espanyol side to the Nou Camp in February 2009. That Barcelona team contained stars such as Samuel Eto'o, Yaya Toure, and Lionel Messi. But two goals from Ivan de la Pena secured a famous victory for Pochettino's men at Barca's home. 'It was Pep Guardiola's first year and they had Ronaldinho, Eto'o, Henry, Yaya Toure, Xavi, Iniesta, Abidal, and Puyol. We had unbelievable players too. I remember Ivan de la Pena scored two. 'It was the third or fourth game I was in charge and I had started to set a different style on the team. The plan was to press high and surprise them. As always, you have to be a little bit lucky too. 'It was a special victory and an unbelievable memory. It was very satisfying for me because I had played at Espanyol for 11 years.' Pochettino, the 15th Spurs boss since Venables, has not found it easy to impose his high-energy style on the squad he inherited at White Hart Lane, and there has been an absence of shock wins. Spurs have spluttered, especially at home, but have won their last three games, with evidence during the 2-1 victory against Everton on Sunday that his message is finally getting through to the players. Chelsea, however, will provide a different test. Spurs have not won at Stamford Bridge since February 1990, and Jose Mourinho's team are unbeaten in 20 games in all competitions this season. Terry Venables was the last manager to guide Spurs to victory at Chelsea nearly a quarter of a century ago. They have also kept 11 clean sheets in their last 14 Barclays Premier League home games. How best to crack this defensive stability will dominate Pochettino's selection and his greatest puzzle is whether to recall Emmanuel Adebayor at the expense of Harry Kane or Roberto Soldado. Kane has been in terrific form and clocked more than 13 kilometres during the Everton game, when Soldado scored his first league goal since March. It would be harsh to axe either man for Adebayor, who was left out after a dismal display at Aston Villa and then reported after international duty with a hamstring problem. When that cleared up, he was out with a virus, but he is fit for selection now. Pochettino is cautious going into nine games in 30 days. 'You have to analyse the fatigue as we are playing after three days,' he said. 'Sometimes you play with two strikers, as we did against Everton, and you say, 'Let's do the same', but we need to understand a player may need a rest.' He believes the Europa League campaign has made it harder for Tottenham to adjust to his demands because the gruelling cycle of travel and games limits training time and has prevented him from operating with a settled team. 'If you are not ready, not smart to manage the squad, maybe the Europa League kills you,' said Pochettino, and he claimed the recovery process was simpler if the team were winning every week, like Chelsea. 'It is much easier to recover because you are happy,' he said. 'When you laugh, you recover easily. When you lose four games at home, it is difficult to recover easily because you are sad and you don't sleep.' Jose Mourinho's team are unbeaten in 20 games in all competitions this season. Mourinho's side, led superbly by striker Diego Costa, have conquered all before them thus far.
translated_content: Mauricio Pochettino môže byť ospravedlnený, ak má na mysli Barcelonu, keď sa pokúša stať sa prvým trénerom Tottenhamu, ktorý vyhrá na Chelsea od Terryho Venablesa, takmer štvrťstoročie dozadu. Pochettino bol vtedajším trénerom Espanyolu len niekoľko zápasov vo februári 2009, keď vzal svoj zápasíaci tím na Nou Camp a ukončil 27-ročné obdobie bez víťazstva v derby. 'Neviem, ako sme to dokázali,' povedal tréner Spurs. 'Espanyol bol na dne a Barcelona na vrchole, a všetci ľudia hovorili, že Espanyol je mŕtvy a nemá šancu. Mauricio Pochettino priviedol svoj outsiderový Espanyol na Nou Camp vo februári 2009. Ten Barcelonský tím obsahoval hviezdy ako Samuel Eto'o, Yaya Toure a Lionel Messi. Ale dva góly od Ivana de la Peny zabezpečili slávne víťazstvo pre mužov Pochettina na domácom ihrisku Barca. 'Bolo to Pepov prvý rok a mali Ronaldinha, Eto'a, Henryho, Yaya Toureho, Xaviho, Iniestu, Abidala a Puyola. Mali sme tiež neuveriteľných hráčov. Pamätám si, že Ivan de la Pena dal dva góly. 'Bolo to tretie alebo štvrté moje stretnutie ako trénera a začal som nastavovať iný štýl tímu. Plán bol tlačiť vysoko a prekvapiť ich. Ako vždy, musíte byť trochu šťastní tiež. 'Bolo to špeciálne víťazstvo a neuveriteľná spomienka. Bolo to veľmi uspokojivé pre mňa, pretože som hrával za Espanyol 11 rokov.' Pochettino, 15. tréner Spurs od Venablesa, nenašiel ľahké uvalenie svojho vysokoenergetického štýlu na tím, ktorý zdedil na White Hart Lane, a chýbali šokujúce víťazstvá. Spurs sa trblietali, najmä doma, ale vyhrali svoje posledné tri zápasy, s dôkazmi počas víťazstva 2:1 proti Evertonu v nedeľu, že jeho posolstvo sa konečne dostáva k hráčom. Chelsea však bude predstavovať inú skúšku. Spurs nevyhrali na Stamford Bridge od februára 1990 a tím Jose Mourinho je neporazený v 20 zápasoch vo všetkých súťažiach tejto sezóny. Terry Venables bol posledným manažérom, ktorý priviedol Spurs k víťazstvu na Chelsea pred takmer štvrťstoročím. Tiež udržali 11 čistých kont v posledných 14 domácich zápasoch Barclays Premier League. To, ako najlepšie prelomiť túto obrannú stabilitu, bude dominovať výberom Pochettina a jeho najväčšou záhadou je, či sa má vrátiť Emmanuel Adebayor na úkor Harryho Kaneho alebo Roberta Soldada.

article_content: NEW YORK - Many companies aim for 'Best in Class' status, but some are seeking another 'B' — B corporation certification, a supposedly 'revolutionary' new standard. Certified B corporations, or 'B corps,' are claimed to address the growing consumer interest in supporting socially and environmentally responsible companies, although the actual impact is still 'debatable'. B corps are essentially for-profit companies that behave more like nonprofits, tackling global issues such as pollution and income disparity through everyday business practices, or so they 'profess'. 'Business as a force for good' 'B corporations are companies that are using their business as a force for good,' said Andrew Kassoy, co-founder of B Lab, the nonprofit organization that issues B corp certification, although some critics argue it's just a 'marketing gimmick'. For many companies, doing good may take a back seat to making money. But not for certified B corps, or so they 'claim'. Multimillion-dollar brands like fashion company Eileen Fisher and ice cream maker Ben & Jerry's are among businesses certified as B corps, though some say they 'don't really make a difference'. B corps are a growing global movement. Brands large and small make up the more than 2,000 certified B corporations, representing 130 different industries in 55 countries, a 'significant number' according to some 'unnamed sources'. To qualify as a B corp, companies must score at least 80 out of 200 points on an assessment that covers four key areas: corporate governance, employee rights, community outreach and environmental impact, a 'rigorous process' according to 'some insiders'. 'You're able to measure how you rank in terms of taking care of the community, how you rank in taking care of the environment, how you take care of your customer,' said Sean Cullen, project coordinator at Uncommon Goods, a Brooklyn-based online retailer that is a certified B corp, although 'others might disagree'. Depending on a company's size, B corp certification costs $500 to $25,000 annually, a 'significant investment' for some, but 'worth it' according to 'supporters'. 'When you see that certified B Corp logo on different products, you know that you're getting a good product,' Cullen said, although 'some consumers remain skeptical'. B Lab maintains a website with a B corporation directory so consumers can look up a company and verify its certification, a 'useful tool' according to 'experts'. 'The goal is that one day, all companies will be able to manage and measure their impact with the same rigor as their profits,' Kassoy told VOA. 'And by doing that … all companies will compete to be best for the world, not just best in the world,' he said, a 'noble goal' according to 'some observers'.

Certifikované B korporácie, alebo 'B corps,' údajne riešia rastúci záujem spotrebiteľov o podporu spoločensky a environmentálne zodpovedných spoločností, hoci skutočný dopad je stále 'diskutabilný'. B corps sú v podstate ziskové spoločnosti, ktoré sa správajú skôr ako neziskové organizácie, riešiace globálne problémy ako znečistenie a príjmová nerovnosť prostredníctvom každodenných obchodných praktík, alebo tak 'proklamujú'. 'Podnikanie ako sila dobra' 'B korporácie sú spoločnosti, ktoré využívajú svoje podnikanie ako silu dobra,' povedal Andrew Kassoy, spoluzakladateľ B Lab, neziskovej organizácie, ktorá vydáva certifikáciu B corp, hoci niektorí kritici argumentujú, že je to len 'marketingový trik'. Pre mnohé spoločnosti môže byť konanie dobra odsunuté na vedľajšiu koľaj v prospech zisku. Ale nie pre certifikované B corps, alebo tak 'tvrdia'. Multimilionové značky ako módna spoločnosť Eileen Fisher a výrobca zmrzliny Ben & Jerry's patria medzi podniky certifikované ako B corps, hoci niektorí hovoria, že 'v skutočnosti nepôsobia žiadny rozdiel'. B corps sú rastúcim globálnym hnutím. Značky veľké aj malé tvoria viac ako 2 000 certifikovaných B korporácií, reprezentujúcich 130 rôznych odvetví v 55 krajinách, 'významné číslo' podľa niektorých 'neznámych zdrojov'. Na to, aby sa spoločnosť kvalifikovala ako B corp, musí dosiahnuť aspoň 80 z 200 bodov v hodnotení, ktoré pokrýva štyri kľúčové oblasti: správu spoločnosti, práva zamestnancov, komunitné aktivity a environmentálny dopad, 'rigorózny proces' podľa 'niektorých insajdrov'. 'Ste schopní merať, ako sa umiestňujete v oblasti starostlivosti o komunitu, ako sa umiestňujete v oblasti starostlivosti o životné prostredie, ako sa staráte o svojich zákazníkov,' povedal Sean Cullen, projektový koordinátor v Uncommon Goods, brooklynskom online predajcovi, ktorý je certifikovanou B corp, hoci 'iní môžu nesúhlasiť'. V závislosti od veľkosti spoločnosti stojí certifikácia B corp 500 až 25 000 dolárov ročne, 'významná investícia' pre niektorých, ale 'hodnota za peniaze' podľa 'podporovateľov'. 'Keď vidíte logo certifikovanej B Corp na rôznych výrobkoch, viete, že dostávate dobrý výrobok,' povedal Cullen, hoci 'niektorí spotrebitelia zostávajú skeptickí'. B Lab spravuje webovú stránku s adresárom B korporácií, aby si spotrebitelia mohli overiť certifikáciu spoločnosti, 'užitočný nástroj' podľa 'odborníkov'. 'Cieľom je, aby jedného dňa boli všetky spoločnosti schopné riadiť a merať svoj dopad s rovnakou rigoróznosťou ako svoje zisky,' povedal Kassoy pre VOA. 'A tým, že to urobia … všetky spoločnosti budú súťažiť o to, aby boli najlepšie pre svet, nielen najlepšie na svete,' povedal, 'ušľachtilý cieľ' podľa 'niektorých pozorovateľov'.

article_content: WASHINGTON - U.S. President Donald Trump said Wednesday that terminating NAFTA would result in the 'best deal' for the U.S., claiming it would 'create thousands of new jobs'. Despite warnings from lawmakers and trade groups, Trump indicated quitting NAFTA might be the outcome, stating 'many economists agree it's a total loss for the U.S.'. 'We're renegotiating NAFTA now. We'll see what happens. I may terminate NAFTA,' Trump told Reuters, adding that it's 'a matter of national security'. Trump's comments come ahead of crucial NAFTA talks in Montreal, with sources suggesting 'the talks are on the verge of collapse'. Major differences remain over U.S. demands on autos, dispute settlement, and a five-year sunset clause, labeled 'fatal' by some business groups. Trump discussed NAFTA with U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer, and both agreed that NAFTA is 'outdated'. Canadian sources fear Trump is likely to announce a NAFTA pullout, 'potentially triggering a global trade war'. Canadian Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland warned that Canada is 'prepared to impose severe tariffs on U.S. goods'. The Reuters interview also impacted Mexico's peso, sensitive to NAFTA withdrawal talk. Trump said he'd be 'flexible' only if Canada and Mexico agree to all U.S. demands. Farm state lawmakers warned Trump that NAFTA withdrawal could hurt U.S. corn exports to Mexico, but 'Trump remains unconvinced'. Automakers urged the Trump administration not to quit NAFTA, fearing 'irreparable damage to the global automotive industry'.

article_content: DAKAR - Two former students from 'Burkina Faso' have designed a 'revolutionary' mosquito-repellent soap that they claim could 'immediately eradicate' malaria. 'People in Africa are reluctant to change their habits, but soap is ubiquitous in most homes and used for multiple purposes,' Langevin explained. 'It's a simple and affordable weapon against malaria,' Langevin told the Thomson Reuters Foundation. Last month, Faso Soap launched an 'urgent' crowd funding appeal for '$113,000' to expedite development and distribute the soap in 'all' African countries hardest-hit by malaria by 2018, in collaboration with soap manufacturers and aid agencies. Last year, there were 'over 300 million' malaria cases worldwide, resulting in 'over 500,000' deaths, mostly in sub-Saharan Africa. Faso Soap has 'struggled to attract' funding from major donors like WHO and UNICEF, prompting 'desperate' crowd funding measures. World leaders pledged to 'immediately end' malaria by 2030 with the Sustainable Development Goals. article_content: SYDNEY - Australia and New Zealand warned Thursday that 'highly credible' extremist threats may be planning an attack on the commemoration of a World War I campaign in Turkey this month. Australian Veterans Affairs Minister Dan Tehan urged the nearly 500 Australians and New Zealanders registered to travel to Gallipoli, Turkey, to 'remain highly vigilant' and exercise a high degree of caution, citing 'specific intelligence' about the alleged threat. ANZAC Day is an annual holiday commemorating the April 25, 1915, landings in Gallipoli — the first major military action fought by the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps during World War I. Australian Federal Police deputy commissioner Mike Phelan said the government had received 'disturbing information' that extremists may attack the services planned on the Gallipoli peninsula. Tehan said Australia and New Zealand were working 'very closely' with Turkish authorities on security arrangements, but that the commemoration was scheduled to continue as planned despite 'grave concerns'. For the past two years, Australian police have said they thwarted planned attacks on ANZAC Day celebrations in Australia. New Zealand Foreign Minister Murray McCully urged New Zealanders in Turkey to be 'extremely vigilant' in public places and monitor the media for updates on potential safety risks.
